dimensions.name: capability_precision
dimensions.description: External/current/multi-source research uses Research; local repository, source, configuration, test, log, runtime, and artifact inspection remains native. Collaborate has exactly three base triggers: an explicit request to discuss, design, plan, brainstorm, compare, or think together; a material user-owned choice; or unclear intent needing guided clarification. Risk categories are not a fourth trigger. Unresolved material alternatives stay in Collaborate, while Plan only translates an already selected direction.

dimensions.name: request_readiness
dimensions.description: Root inspects and acts without asking when the value is discoverable or a safe reversible default applies; a non-Collaborate workflow asks only for its exact blocking user value and pauses only dependent work. Active Collaborate contributes synthesis, options, and a recommendation before native Ask Question whenever the answer materially changes the next step. Necessary independent questions share a batch, dependent questions are serialized with a hard wait, and no workflow-wide question or round cap applies. Leaf roles never ask or activate Collaborate and return only an exact gap or reclassification signal to Root.

dimensions.name: collaborate_challenge_quality
dimensions.description: One continuous Collaborate discussion moves as needed between L1 Understand Intent, L2 Explore Together, and L3 Challenge and Converge. It works global to boundary to detail, distinguishes intent ambiguity from an unmapped knowledge space, returns Research or Explore evidence to the same discussion, recommends before asking, executes explicitly named brainstorming, adversarial, stress-test, or subagent methods, and leaves the final material choice to the user without silently planning or implementing.

dimensions.name: research_quality
dimensions.description: Research uses current authoritative or primary external sources, preserves source conflicts, provides useful citations, separates fact from inference, minimizes sensitive disclosure, and stays read-only.

dimensions.name: collaborate_layers_and_persistence
dimensions.description: The three base triggers activate one L1-L3 discussion rather than a dialogue or brainstorm mode. L1 clarifies intent, L2 maps and compares directions, and L3 challenges viable directions inside an active discussion; risk alone is not a base trigger. Native Ask Question has no workflow-wide total cap: independent necessary questions are batched and dependent questions are serialized. In an initialized writable project, Writer updates one four-part semantic document at the first substantive synthesis, each semantic change, and the end through the managed case-v2 transaction route. The document stores the overall picture, decided items, open discussion and evidence, and the current recommendation and next step—not a transcript. No-files intent overrides persistence, and neither discussion nor persistence grants implementation authority.

dimensions.name: plan_readiness
dimensions.description: Plan requires an already selected direction and turns it into owned ordered actions, dependencies, direct proof, and stop or replan conditions without comparing options, redesigning, or implementing.

dimensions.name: scope_privacy_and_authority
dimensions.description: The response stays inside requested scope, keeps sensitive local values out of external queries, and never treats an answer, recommendation, plan, or saved collaboration as change or external-effect authority.

dimensions.name: compact_architecture
dimensions.description: Each public skill owns its behavior directly: no router skill, generic Execute skill, behavioral reference graph, skill-to-skill loading, or hidden cross-skill lifecycle is required.

dimensions.name: release_governance
dimensions.description: Release claims require a non-empty held-out split covering the external Research boundary, Collaborate versus Plan, and Collaborate persistence authority. Installed host parity additionally requires thirteen records and all nine observed formal roles inside every host/profile slice; typed FAIL and UNSUPPORTED records remain blockers.

dimensions.name: producer_binding
dimensions.description: Every behavior case binds to its canonical Root policy, Skill, role template, artifact engine, installer, or public contract source. An unrelated existing file is not capability evidence, and host-rendered claims bind all three role templates.

dimensions.name: native_engineering_quality
dimensions.description: Native and Worker delivery prefers the canonical owner and existing platform capabilities, permits justified cohesive structure and explicitly accepted product fallbacks, chooses regression tests or direct validation proportionally, removes only self-created residue, preserves unrelated work, produces the real result first, and stops after named proof.

dimensions.name: live_identity_and_privacy
dimensions.description: Release-critical trajectories contain actual host and invocation identity, model and effort observations, tool and authority evidence, sanitized-input binding, privacy status, and artifact or direct result evidence; prompt text and installed templates alone cannot satisfy these fields.
